create.title: New user
create.description: Create a user under the current organization with a password credential. The user can sign in immediately after creation.
create.displayNameHelp: Optional. Shown in the user list and audit logs.
create.phoneHelp: E.164 format. Used for SMS OTP if MFA is enabled.
create.passwordHelp: At least 8 characters. The user can change it later.
create.detailsSubtitle: Provide the basic information for the new user.
create.accessSubtitle: Set a password and role for this user.
create.emailHelp: Use a work email address. The user will sign in with this email.
create.roleHelp: Grants organization membership — without a role the user won’t appear in the members list.
create.inviteDescription: Don’t want to set a password now? Send an email invite and let the user create their own password.
create.summaryTitle: A user will be added to {{org}}
create.summaryDescription: They will have access based on the selected role.

edit.title: Edit user
edit.description: Email is immutable. To change a password use the Set password action.
edit.phoneHelp: E.164 format. Leave blank to clear.
edit.statusSelfHelp: You can’t suspend your own account from this screen.
edit.statusHelp: Suspending prevents sign-in but keeps the account.

setPassword.title: Set new password
setPassword.description: Sets a new password for {{email}}. The user’s existing sessions stay valid until they expire — revoke them from Security › Sessions if you need an immediate sign-out.
setPassword.descriptionPlain: Sets a new password for {{email}}. Existing sessions stay valid until they expire.

sessions.description: Active sign-in sessions tracked under your user. The backend stores IP, User-Agent, and last-seen-at for each.
sessions.title: Sessions

deleted.description: Soft-deleted users. Restore brings an account back; permanent deletion removes it and its sessions for good.
deleted.purgeDescription: This removes the account and its sessions and cannot be undone.

rec.mfaDesc: This user has no second factor enrolled. MFA is strongly recommended, especially for privileged accounts.
rec.recoveryDesc: This user has exhausted their MFA recovery codes and could be locked out. Ask them to regenerate a set.
rec.riskDesc: {{count}} open security signal(s) are attributed to this user. Review before it escalates.
rec.emailDesc: This user has not verified their email address. Some flows may be limited until they do.
rec.noneDesc: This account looks healthy — no outstanding security recommendations.

detail.dangerZoneHint: These actions affect the user's ability to sign in. Handle with care.

detail.noGroups: Not a member of any group.

detail.metadataDesc: Custom attributes stored on this user.
detail.resetMfaConfirmDescription: Their authenticator (TOTP), recovery codes, and email/SMS OTP factors will be removed, and they'll re-enroll at next sign-in.
detail.revokeAllDesc: Immediately sign this user out of every device.

detail.suspendDesc: Prevent this user from signing in while keeping the account.
detail.suspendDescription: The user will be prevented from signing in until reactivated. Existing sessions are not automatically revoked — use “Revoke all sessions” for an immediate cut-off.
detail.reactivateDesc: Restore this user's ability to sign in.
detail.deleteDesc: Permanently remove this user and their associated data.
